scope: Node.js verification tests with deterministic mocked HTTP payloads; no browser UI, real network, or physical GPS

results.name: Accepts a structurally valid manifest and a real SHA-256 file record
Rejects demo placeholders, zero-size files and invalid hashes
Rejects a declared total size that differs from the sum of payload sizes
Rejects absolute paths, parent traversal and duplicate file paths
Downloads and verifies each payload by exact size and SHA-256
Rejects an altered manifest file list using aggregate SHA-256
Rejects payload with incorrect byte length
Rejects payload with incorrect SHA-256 even if its byte length matches
Rejects missing HTTP resources without marking package verified
Installer commits only after file verification and keeps prior stable package on failure
Manifest describes real, non-empty local data files with matching SHA-256 and aggregate hash
Release cache and version identifiers are aligned to Batch 47
